{{Quote|Where's this Sarkan coming in from?''"<br />"''Sector Three-Besh. As you can see, we have attempted to send a force adequate to overcome any resistance.''"<br />"''Yeah. And you're sure it's a Sarkan?''"<br />"''Its transponder ID has been checked. The ship itself is a Corellian Action-Keynne XII, rarely seen in this part of the Core except under Sarkan authority.''"<br />"''Sounds like a Sarkan, all right. You go ahead and do your intercept. Maybe we'll come up later and have a look.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and a member of the [[Iphigin Spaceport Directorate]]|<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bes Ber Bikade sector''', also known as the '''Three-Besh sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Borkyne]], [[Dura-Kahn]], [[Epica]], [[KyLessia]], [[Roona/Legends|Roona]] and [[Troxar]]. The sector was located in the southern portion of the region and bordered the [[Andirma sector/Legends|Andirma sector]], the [[Arc d'Stot sector/Legends|Arc d'Stot sector]], the [[Rocantor sector/Legends|Rocantor sector]], the [[Hakartha sector/Legends|Hakartha sector]], the [[Vulcusion sector/Legends|Vulcusion sector]], and the [[Tregillis sector/Legends|Tregillis sector]].
